'''''Muhlenbergia''''' is a genus of plants in the [[grass family]].<ref>{{cite book |last=Schreber |first=Johann Christian Daniel von |date=1789 |title=Genera Plantarum Eorumque Characteres Naturales Secundum Numerum, Figuram, Situm, & Proportionem Omnium Fructificationis Partium |edition= 8th |volume=1 |page=[{{Google Books |id=nBtQAAAAcAAJ |page=44 |plainurl=yes}} 44]}}</ref><ref name="Tropicos" /><ref>{{cite encyclopedia |last=Peterson |first=P. M. |date=2000 |contribution=Systematics of the Muhlenbergiinae (Chloridoideae: Eragrostideae) |pages=195–212 |editor1-first=S. W. L. |editor1-last=Jacobs |editor2-first=J. |editor2-last=Everett |encyclopedia=Grasses: Systematics and Evolution |publisher=[[CSIRO]] |place=Melbourne |isbn=9780643090101 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Peterson |first1=P. M. |first2=K. |last2=Romaschenko |first3=G. |last3=Johnson |date=2010 |title=A phylogeny and classification of the Muhlenbergiinae (Poaceae: Chloridoideae: Cynodonteae) based on plastid and nuclear DNA sequences |journal=American Journal of Botany |volume=97 |issue=9 |pages=1532–1554 |doi=10.3732/ajb.0900359|pmid=21616906 }}</ref>

The genus is named in honor of the German-American amateur botanist [[Gotthilf Heinrich Ernst Muhlenberg]] (1753-1815).<ref name="china">{{eFloras|2|121292|Muhlenbergia |first1=Zhen-lan |last1=Wu |first2=Paul M. |last2=Peterson |volume=22}}</ref> Many of the species are known by the common name '''muhly'''.
The greatest number are native to the [[southwestern United States]] and [[Mexico]], but there are also native species in [[Canada]], [[Central America|Central]] and [[South America]] and in [[Asia]].<ref name="china"/><ref>{{cite book |last=Beetle |first=A.A. |date=1995 |title=Las Gramíneas de México |volume=4 |pages=1–342 |publisher=Secretaria de Agricultura y Recursos Hidraulícos, COTECOCA |place=México D.F.}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last=Bor |first=N. L. |date=1960 |title=The grasses of Burma, Ceylon, India, and Pakistan, excluding Bambuseae |publisher=Pergamon Press |place=Oxford |asin=B004X2E4EY}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Giraldo-Cañas |first1=D. |first2=P. M. |last2=Peterson |date=2009 |title=El género ''Muhlenbergia'' (Poaceae: Chloridoideae: Cynodonteae: Muhlenbergiinae) en Colombia |url=https://revistas.unal.edu.co/index.php/cal/article/view/36104/37520 |periodical=Caldasia |volume=31 |issue=2 |pages=269–302 |jstor=23641918}}</ref>
